methodologyNotes: Covers standalone digital pianos with fully weighted, piano-style keyboards sold at a published US MSRP/typical street price in USD. Includes portable slab pianos, home console/cabinet models, and stage pianos. Excludes non-weighted arranger keyboards, synths, MIDI controllers without onboard sound, and acoustic/hybrid grands. keyCount is the number of keys (typically 88). keyAction is the manufacturer's weighted/hammer action type as printed on the spec sheet (e.g. graded-hammer, PHA-4, wooden-key), verbatim enum text. keyMaterial is the keytop surface: plastic, simulated-ebony-ivory, or wood. polyphonyNotes is maximum polyphony in notes. voiceCount is the number of built-in instrument voices/tones (integer). speakerPowerWatts is total onboard amplifier output in watts (sum of all channels); null if the model has no built-in speakers (typical for stage pianos). formFactor is one of: portable, console, stage, upright-cabinet. bluetoothConnectivity is one of: none, midi, audio, midi-audio. usbToHost is a boolean for a USB-to-host MIDI/audio port. weightKg is instrument weight in kilograms excluding any optional stand. widthMm is cabinet width in millimeters. Price is US MSRP/typical street price in USD.

A retailer, West Music, listed the PX-S1100BK at street "Sale Price $729.99" with a stated "MSRP Regular Price $1,029.99", but that MSRP exceeds $1,000 and conflicts with the review's "sub-$1000" claim, and it is a single-source sale figure. products.provenance: The Casio specification sheet on manuals.co.uk (identified as Casio Privia PX-S1100 / PX-S1100WE, EAN 4971850362630) confirmed the exact model and stated verbatim: 88 keys, Maximum polyphony 192 notes, Tones quantity 18, RMS rated power 16 W, Width 1322 mm, Weight 11200 g, USB Type-A/Type-B, and Bluetooth (version 5.0). Neither authoritative source published an exact US MSRP (review says only "sub-$1000"), and the one retailer figure found (West Music, $729.99 street / $1,029.99 MSRP) was internally inconsistent, so the price is left null.
